The main takeaway from our work is that
PPNs can be tailored to bind small cations, which can be exploited for energy storage applications.
PPNs can provide a platform to tune the formal potentials of redox-active groups by cation coordination, which can be exploited to enhance electrochemical performance of PPNs.
PPNs can be designed to interact with a specific cation, which can be used to optimize the energy density of the device.
